manifest.notes: Sepolia only (11155111). LaunchToken has no constructor arguments. ImdCardPayment is fully configured at construction with no initialization calls or owner/admin functions. Its immutable settlement recipient is $owner, resolved exclusively from policy; independent review must confirm that this beneficiary is the intended settlement operator. Mock prices use eight USD decimals: $20 per Claude-month pack and $0.01 per IMD. ceil(20 / 0.01) plus 8% gives 2160 IMD per pack; the contract permits 1-3 packs per transaction with a 0% service fee. Payments are forwarded immediately to the settlement recipient. The $60 float target and full IMD refund if no card arrives within 15 minutes are off-chain operator obligations, not enforced by the contract; the event deadline is not a refund mechanism. Operator fulfillment, refunds and beneficiary authorization remain review concerns. The pool pairs with native ETH without a hook; initialPrice is decimal sqrtPriceX96 (2^96), subject to any pinned policy opening-price override by services. Policy and signed artifact linkage belong to services.
